title: 2026年高考英语真题1 · 语法填空（Daji: The Big Open-Air Fairs 大集民俗）

items.label: 语篇语法特征 Grammar Profile
items.correctText: 非谓语与从句连接词高频
opts: 非谓语与从句连接词高频

items.label: 语篇结构 Structure
items.correctText: 总—分：起源时间→社交功能→采买归途
opts: 总—分：起源时间→社交功能→采买归途

hints: 介绍一种民俗现象的文章，时态会以什么为主？
括号里的 hold/draw/head 提示你需要判断什么？
三段分别讲了大集的哪些侧面？
why: 介绍性说明文以一般现在时为基调，穿插历史过去时。
括号给动词时，先判'谓语还是非谓语'再判'主动还是被动'。
起源时间→社交功能→采买归途，说明文的总分推进。

items.label: 主题语境·大类
items.hint: 集市、贸易、节日、邻里——属于哪类主题群？
items.why: 传统集市是社会文化与经济生活现象。

items.label: 主题语境·具体话题
items.hint: lunar calendar、Spring Festival、street food 把场景锚定在哪里？
items.why: 农历日期、传统节日、集市交易——民俗文化话题。

items.label: 主旨 Main Idea
items.correctText: 大集的起源、功能与今日集市生活的图景

opts.text: 大集的起源、功能与今日集市生活的图景
大集正在被超市彻底取代
opts.err: 反向设置（末段仍在写热闹采购）

opts.text: 大集商品价格普遍偏高

items.hint: 三段的'起源—功能—风貌'合起来在介绍什么？
items.why: 说明对象是大集这一民俗现象的来龙去脉与现在。

items.label: 基调 Tone / Attitude
items.hint: 作者是在介绍知识还是在为 大集 辩护或促销？
items.why: 客观陈述起源与功能，无褒贬倾斜。

paraFuncs.hint: lunar calendar、Han Dynasty——第一段讲的是大集的什么？
paraFuncs.why: 时间依据与历史起源，属背景说明。

paraFuncs.hint: crowd into、chat、street performances——第二段写大集的哪一面？
paraFuncs.why: 买卖之外的社交娱乐功能。

paraFuncs.hint: fill shopping bags、cheaper——离集前人们收获了什么？
paraFuncs.why: 以物美价廉的采购收束，呼应集市的交易本义。

paraSummaries.summary: Daji, held on special lunar dates and festivals, dates back to the Han Dynasty as a trading custom.
Beyond trading, daji are social occasions where crowds enjoy street food and performances.
Before heading home, visitors buy fresh, cheaper produce from local farmers.

trace.stem: It is also common for them 56.________(hold) during traditional Chinese festivals
trace.correctQuote: It is also common for them 56.________(hold)
trace.hint: them 与 hold 之间是主动还是被动关系？for sb ____ 结构用什么形式？
trace.why: for them to be held 复合结构；集会被举行，不定式被动式。

trace.stem: The exact dates and 57.________(frequent) of daji vary from region to region.
trace.correctQuote: The exact dates and 57.________(frequent) of daji vary from region to region.
trace.hint: and 前后的 dates 与空格是并列名词吗？frequent 的名词形式是什么？
trace.why: dates and frequency 并列名词作主语；frequent→frequency 派生。

trace.stem: Daji originated from the ancient folk custom of trading goods, which dates back to 58.________ Han Dynasty.
trace.correctQuote: Daji originated from the ancient folk custom of trading goods, which dates back to 58.________
trace.why: the Han Dynasty——朝代前定冠词为固定用法。

trace.stem: As transportation and communication 59.________(be) underdeveloped at that time
trace.correctQuote: As transportation and communication 59.________(be) underdeveloped at that time
trace.hint: and 连接的两个主语是单还是复？at that time 把时态定在哪？
trace.why: 复数主语+过去时间状语→were。

trace.stem: it was very difficult for households to obtain daily 60.________(necessity)
trace.correctQuote: it was very difficult for households to obtain daily 60.________(necessity)
trace.hint: daily necessities 是什么意思？可数名词泛指日用品用单数还是复数？
trace.why: daily necessities（日常必需品）固定复数；necessary 是形容词。

trace.stem: people gathered at specific locations on set days to trade their surplus items 61.________ what they needed.
trace.correctQuote: people gathered at specific locations on set days to trade their surplus (剩余的) items 61.________
trace.hint: trade A ____ B——以A换B的固定搭配是哪个介词？
trace.why: trade A for B 以A换B；剩余物品换所需。

trace.stem: 62.________(draw) by the aroma of street food, they line up in front of stands
trace.correctQuote: 62.________(draw) by the aroma ( 香味) of street food
trace.hint: people 是'吸引'的发出者还是承受者？句首状语用什么形式？
trace.why: be drawn by 被吸引；句首状语用过去分词 Drawn。

trace.stem: they line up in front of stands 63.________ serve steaming dumplings and hot noodle soup.
trace.correctQuote: they line up in front of stands 63.________ serve steaming
trace.hint: 先行词 stands 是人还是物？从句缺主语还是状语？
trace.why: stands（摊位）指物且从句缺主语→that/which；what 不能引导定语从句。

trace.stem: Before 64.________(head) home, they fill their shopping bags with fresh fruit and vegetables
trace.hint: Before 是介词还是连词？介词后动词用什么形式？
trace.why: Before 介词后接动名词 heading；head home 动词化'回家'。

trace.stem: at prices significantly 65.________(cheap) than those found in supermarkets.
trace.hint: 句中的 than 把空格推向哪种形式？significantly 修饰什么？
trace.why: than 提示比较级 cheaper；significantly 修饰比较级，不叠加 more。

inter.hint: 从'何时何地起源'推进到'人们除了买卖还做什么'，是不是功能的延伸？
逛集之后写归途采购，叙事是否继续沿时间线推进？

intra.correctText: which dates back to...（非限制性定语从句）
intra.item: a folk custom which dates back to the Han Dynasty
intra.hint: which 指代前文的什么？从句缺不缺成分？
intra.why: which 作从句主语修饰 custom——用 which 而非 that（前有逗号）。

intra.correctText: Drawn by... 过去分词作原因状语
intra.item: Drawn by the aroma of street food, they line up in front of stands
intra.hint: 排队的原因是什么？这个原因是谁承受的？
intra.why: 被香味吸引→排队的逻辑，Drawn 表被动原因。

intra.item: shopping bags / fresh fruit and vegetables / local farmers / prices
intra.hint: bags、farmers、prices 共同描绘了哪个画面？
intra.why: 购物语义场收束全文，呼应集市的交易本义。

argument.hint: for example、such as 后的具体日期与节日起什么作用？
argument.why: 举出具体日期与节日，让'时间分布'的说明落地。

sentences.kind: It is common for sb/sth to be done
sentences.sen: It is also common for them 56.________(hold) during traditional Chinese holidays such as the Spring Festival and the Mid-Autumn Festival
sentences.ana: for them to be held：不定式复合结构+被动——them（大集）与 hold 是被动关系。

sentences.kind: 过去分词短语作原因状语
sentences.sen: Drawn by the aroma of street food, they line up in front of stands that serve steaming dumplings and hot noodle soup.
sentences.ana: Drawn by 状语（被动原因）+ that serve 定语从句修饰 stands——一句串联因果与场景。

sentences.kind: 介词短语+比较级+than 替代
sentences.sen: they fill their shopping bags with fresh fruit and vegetables from local farmers, at prices significantly cheaper than those found in supermarkets
sentences.ana: at prices 短语表条件；cheaper than those... 中 those 替代 prices，found in 过去分词后置。

rhetoric.sen: The exact dates and frequency of daji vary from region to region.
rhetoric.ana: 形容词 frequent 加 -y 变名词 frequency——57 空的考点原型。

rhetoric.sen: it was very difficult for households to obtain daily necessities
rhetoric.ana: necessary→necessity→necessities 三级派生，60 空考点。

corpus.zh: 追溯到（常与过去时间连用）

items.label: A · 写作目的
items.correctText: 介绍大集这一民俗的起源、功能与风貌
opts: 介绍大集这一民俗的起源、功能与风貌
呼吁保护即将消失的大集
比较城乡购物方式优劣
items.hint: 三段合起来是在完成对什么的说明？
items.why: 起源+功能+风貌——民俗介绍的完整闭环。

items.label: B · 语篇结构
items.correctText: 总分推进：背景起源→功能→今日风貌
opts: 总分推进：背景起源→功能→今日风貌
items.hint: 第一段的'过去'与第三段的'现在'构成怎样的推进？
items.why: 说明文标准推进，各段功能清晰。

items.label: C · 最典型考点
items.hint: 括号里给出的动词最多——它们考的是同一个大类吗？
items.why: 不定式被动、过去分词、动名词——非谓语三分形态全覆盖。

items.label: D · 读者价值
items.correctText: 民俗文化与语法知识双收获
opts: 民俗文化与语法知识双收获
items.hint: 读完既知道了什么现象，又练习了什么能力？
items.why: 语篇载体为文化，任务载体为语法。

定语从句——修饰名词的从句（that/which/who）
构词法——派生、转换与复合
